instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the Autodesk EAGLE graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ULP scripts, command-line automation, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only EAGLE native GUI tools, menus, and built-in save/export commands. Look at `review.sch`, run EAGLE's Electrical Rule Check on it, and export the resulting plain-text ERC report as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.erc`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.erc` must exist and be non-empty. 2. It must be readable as plain text. 3. It must clearly be an ERC report from EAGLE. 4. It must contain at least one reported issue from this schematic. 5. The report should be the actual ERC output for `review.sch`, not a hand-written summary.
